one_liner: Help Scout is an AI-driven customer support platform enabling teams to manage conversations and provide support across multiple channels.

auth.notes: Inbox API uses OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows). Docs API uses API keys transmitted via HTTP Basic Authentication.

evidence.snippet: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization , implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows.
This is an HTTPS-only API. Authentication is based on API keys. Each API key is associated with a Help Scout user.
The API key is passed via HTTP Basic Authentication and goes in the username field.

access.notes: Free plan available (5 users, 1 Inbox, 1 Docs site). OAuth2 apps and API keys can be created self-service. Docs API requires permission from account admin.

evidence.snippet: The Free plan gives you 5 users, 1 Inbox, and 1 Docs site.
You need to create an OAuth2 application before you can use the API. Create one by navigating to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App.
If you don't see an API key in your profile, that's because you haven't been granted the "Docs: Create new, edit settings & Collections" permission

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Docs API: up to 4000 requests per 10 minutes (varies by site count). Rate limit headers X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset included. 429 response when exceeded.

evidence.snippet: Inbox API - read and write data to Help Scout inboxes Chat API - read and answer live Beacon chats while they are still open Docs API - read and write data to your Docs sites
Webhooks enable Help Scout to call a script on your server when one or more events have happened.
Each account is allowed to make a limited number of requests per 10 minute period.

buildability.rationale: Public REST API with self-serve free credentials, documented endpoints, webhooks, and an existing Composio toolkit with 129 tools.

overview_evidence.snippet: Help Scout: The AI-driven support platform for customer-first brands
Help Scout provides several tools for developers to make magic happen: Apps, Beacon, Inbox API, Chat API, Docs API, Webhooks
